rows.jp: 支倉曜子は部屋に戻った。
rows.en: Youko Hasekura returned to her room.

ghs.en: Hasekura Youko returned to her one-room apartment.
Youko: "..."

rows.jp: テリトリーに戻ったところで、気をゆるめる曜子ではない。
rows.en: Even on her own territory, Youko did not let down her guard.

ghs.en: Yet relaxing one's guard upon returning to her territory is not like Youko.

rows.jp: 堆く積まれた書物の塔をかいくぐり、鞄を寝台に放りつつ機材の電源を入れた。
rows.en: She threaded between towers of books, tossed her bag onto the bed, and switched on the equipment.

ghs.en: She slipped through a tower of books piled up high, tossed her bag on the bed, and turned on the power for her machines.

rows.jp: 六畳間には三セットのパソコンと液晶モニタがある。
rows.en: The six-tatami room held three computers and their LCD monitors.

ghs.en: In the six-tatami space there exist three PCs with LCD monitors.

rows.jp: 部屋に沿ってＬ字に組み合わされたラックは、見るからに手狭だ。
rows.en: The racks formed an L along the walls, with little room to spare.

ghs.en: The rack, arranged in an L shape and set parallel to the room, is discernibly thin.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese says that the L-shaped rack is visibly too cramped or insufficient for the room. The English instead describes the rack's physical thickness.
ghs.remedy: obviously too cramped

highlights.text: discernibly thin

rows.jp: 万全の盗撮をするには三台すべてを用いるが、今はブラウジング専用機とも言える一台をのぞき使用されることはほとんどない。
rows.en: Thorough covert filming took all three. These days, she rarely used any but the one that was practically dedicated to browsing.

ghs.en: While all three were utilized for a flawless stalking, now, except for one machine that could be said to be dedicated for browsing, they are almost never used.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese specifically refers to covert filming or voyeuristic surveillance using all three machines. 'Stalking' is a different act and loses the camera-based meaning.
ghs.remedy: thorough covert filming

highlights.text: flawless stalking

rows.jp: 相手がいないからだ。
rows.en: There was no one left to watch.

ghs.en: Because their target is no more.

rows.jp: 天井まではめ殺されている書棚には、各種の専門書が詰め込まれている。
rows.en: Built-in shelves reached the ceiling, packed with technical books of every kind.

ghs.en: Bookshelves are infixed in the wall, so tall they seemed to stab through the ceiling, and crammed to the brim with specialized technical books of all kinds.

rows.jp: 日本語だけでなく英語や独逸語もあり、雑然としていた。
rows.en: Japanese, English, German—all jumbled together.

ghs.en: Not only in Japanese, but also in English and in German, all jumbled together.

rows.jp: 読めるなら、言語別に区分けする意味などない。
rows.en: If she could read them, there was no point sorting them by language.

ghs.en: She can read all of them, so dividing them by language has little point.

rows.jp: 本は棚から溢れ、床にいくつもの柱を打ち立てている。
rows.en: The books had spilled from the shelves and raised pillars across the floor.

ghs.en: The overflow from the shelves ends in a number of pillars on the floor.

rows.jp: 最近は手をつけられることがないのか、どの柱も薄いホコリの層をかぶっていた。

ghs.en: Perhaps because she's not laid hand on them recently, these columns were also capped by a thin layer of dust.

rows.jp: 他には工具類やハイテク関連の機材が目立つ。
rows.en: Tools and high-tech equipment also stood out.

ghs.en: Tools and high-tech related machines also attract the eye.

rows.jp: ものは多いが、根元的には簡素な部屋だ。
rows.en: The room held many things, yet at heart it was austere.

ghs.en: There is much inside, but fundamentally, this is plain room.

rows.jp: 目的を達するための部屋。
rows.en: A room for getting things done.

ghs.en: It is a room that exists for the purpose of achieving a goal.

rows.jp: 娯楽と呼ぶものは、たった一つをのぞいて存在しない。
rows.en: There was only one thing in it for entertainment.

ghs.en: Except for a single solitary thing, nothing exists here that can be said to be for entertainment.

rows.jp: 知識と手段に満ちた部屋。
rows.en: A room full of knowledge and the means to act.

ghs.en: It's a room filled with knowledge and with means.

rows.jp: そんな私室であった。
rows.en: That was her room.

ghs.en: That is what her private room was.

rows.jp: 椅子に座り日課をこなす。

ghs.en: She sits in the chair, performing her daily routine.

rows.jp: メールを確認し、ニュースを流し読む。
rows.en: She checked her email and skimmed the news.

ghs.en: Checking the mail, skimming the news.

ghs.en: Corrupted politicians,

rows.en: Juvenile crime.

ghs.en: juvenile criminals,

ghs.en: concealment of medical malpractice.

rows.en: The world did not change.

ghs.en: The world never changes.

ghs.en: The number of suicides has been steadily increasing as well.

ghs.remedy: From the page about suicide, Youko casually followed a link to a message board, where her eyes stopped.

highlights.text: An innocent forum post was flowing by on that webpage about suicide, and it's on it that Youko's eyes stopped.

rows.jp: ラジオ、という単語があったからだ。
rows.en: The word radio had caught her eye.

ghs.en: Because there was the word, "radio".

rows.jp: サイトの内容は、他愛ないオカルトだった。
rows.en: The site was full of paranormal nonsense.

ghs.en: The contents of the site itself were silly and innocently about occultism.

rows.jp: ラジオから幽霊の声が、とか、神の声が、とか。

ghs.en: You can hear the voice of a ghost, or maybe of a god, from the radio.

rows.jp: 聞くと自殺を止める力があるらしい。
rows.en: Listening to it was supposedly enough to stop someone from killing themselves.

ghs.en: It seems to have the strength to stop the suicides of those who hear.

rows.jp: すぐに興味を失う。
rows.en: She lost interest at once.

ghs.en: She quickly loses interest.

rows.jp: 投資の動向を調べるため、国外のサイトをいくつかチェックする。
rows.en: She checked several foreign sites to follow investment trends.

ghs.en: She goes on to several foreign sites, in order to check the trends of her investments.

rows.jp: ここまでは機械的だ。
rows.en: Everything up to this point was mechanical.

ghs.en: Up to this point, it has all been mechanical.

rows.jp: 普段は、必要に応じて読書をしたり機材をいじったりする。
rows.en: Ordinarily, she would read or tinker with her equipment as the need arose.

ghs.en: Customarily, she reads books as necessary, or she fiddles around with her machines.

rows.jp: だが今日は予定もない。
rows.en: But she had nothing planned today.

ghs.en: However, today she has no plans.

rows.jp: ここ数日、いくつか気になる動きを見せた銘柄を、オンライントレードで調整する。
rows.en: She used an online brokerage to adjust several positions that had shown unusual movement over the past few days.

ghs.en: The last few days she has been making adjustment on the online trading of a number of stocks that have been showing interesting movement.

rows.jp: 資金はあっていい。
rows.en: Money was never a bad thing to have.

ghs.en: Having capital is good.

rows.jp: いざというときに役に立つ。
rows.en: It could come in handy in an emergency.

ghs.en: It's useful when push comes to shove.

rows.jp: 体力もだ。
rows.en: The same was true of physical strength.

ghs.en: So is physical strength.

rows.jp: 今日もトレーニングだけは済ませてきた。
rows.en: At least she had done her training today.

ghs.en: And today as well ended up being nothing but training.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese says that today too she at least finished her training. The English instead says that training was the only thing she did all day.
ghs.remedy: today too, she at least finished her training

highlights.text: today as well ended up being nothing but training

rows.jp: これら自動的に消化できる行動は、曜子の維持に貢献した。

ghs.en: These motions, performed in practiced automatism, contribute to the preservation of Youko.

rows.jp: かつては目的があった。

ghs.en: Previously, there had been an objective:

rows.jp: 自分を高めて外に出る。
rows.en: Improve herself, then go out into the world.

ghs.en: to make herself worthy and capable, and leave for the outside.

rows.jp: 支倉の屋敷にいた頃は、それがすべてだと思っていた。
rows.en: While she still lived at the Hasekura estate, she had believed that was everything.

ghs.en: In the time she spent at the Hasekura Estate, that, she thought, was everything.

rows.jp: そのための研鑽。
rows.en: All her discipline had served that end.

ghs.en: And for that purpose she devoted herself to study.

rows.jp: けれど対象はすり替わってしまった。
rows.en: But the object of all that effort had changed.

ghs.en: However, that target ended up being replaced,

ghs.remedy: in synchronization with the definition of her other half

highlights.text: at the same time when she established she was half of a body

rows.jp: 未熟な伴侶を守るために、能力は磨かれるようになった。
rows.en: She began honing her abilities to protect an immature partner.

ghs.en: Her skills were then being polished for the sake of protecting this inexperienced half of her.

rows.jp: そして彼は失われた。
rows.en: Then he was lost.

ghs.en: And then he went away.

ghs.remedy: he was lost

highlights.text: he went away

rows.jp: 指標さえ消えた。
rows.en: Even her point of reference was gone.

ghs.en: All that points to him had vanished.

ghs.remedy: Even her guiding objective

highlights.text: All that points to him

rows.jp: それでもなお動き続ける自身の機械的な面を、曜子はどう思っているのか。

ghs.en: And yet, what could Youko be thinking of these mechanical aspects of her own self that still continue their motions?

rows.jp: 乏しい表情から、うかがい知ることはできない。
rows.en: Her face gave no answer.

ghs.en: Understanding via the divination of her rare facial expressions is impossible.

rows.jp: パソコンの電源を落とす。
rows.en: She shut down the computer.

ghs.en: She switched off the power of her PC.

rows.jp: 部屋は一気に暗くなる。
rows.en: The room went dark all at once.

ghs.en: The room grows dark in an instant.

rows.jp: 曜子は椅子に座ったままだ。
rows.en: Youko remained in her chair.

ghs.en: Youko continues to sit in her chair.

rows.jp: ノルマは終わった。
rows.en: She had met her quota.

ghs.en: Her assignment was over.

rows.jp: もうすることはない。
rows.en: There was nothing more to do.

ghs.en: Other things to do she doesn't have.

ghs.remedy: She has nothing else to do.

highlights.text: Other things to do she doesn't have.

rows.jp: 時計を見る。寝るには早すぎた。
rows.en: She checked the clock. It was far too early for bed.

ghs.en: She looks at the clock. Far too early to sleep.

rows.jp: ふと。
rows.en: Then—

ghs.en: Inadvertently,

rows.jp: 壁にかけられた、部屋で唯一の娯楽品に目がとまる。
rows.en: Her eyes fell on the room’s one diversion, hanging on the wall.

ghs.en: her eyes stopped on the sole and only item of entertainment that was hanging from the wall.

rows.jp: 薄いカード型のラジオだ。
rows.en: A slim, card-shaped radio.

ghs.en: It's a thin, card-type radio.

rows.jp: スイッチは入りっぱなしになっている。
rows.en: Its power had been left on.

ghs.en: She ended up leaving it switched on.

rows.jp: その周波数が、なにかを訴えかけたことはない。
rows.en: Nothing had ever called to her through that frequency.

ghs.en: She has never heard an appeal or anything of the sort on that frequency, not once.

rows.jp: 時折、遠い地の放送がまぎれることもある。
rows.en: Now and then, a broadcast from some faraway place bled through.

ghs.en: Occasionally, broadcasts from some distant land have flown in.

rows.jp: それだけだ。
rows.en: Nothing more.

ghs.en: That, and nothing more.

rows.jp: 曜子はため息をついて、無為な時間に身を任せた。
rows.en: Youko sighed and surrendered herself to the empty hours.

ghs.en: Youko released a sigh, and devoted herself to hours of idle inactivity.

rows.jp: どれくらい経過しただろうか。
rows.en: How much time passed?

ghs.en: How many have even passed by now?

ghs.remedy: How much time has passed by now?

highlights.text: How many have even passed by now?

rows.jp: 浅く眠っていた曜子は、瞬時に覚醒した。
rows.en: Dozing lightly, Youko snapped awake in an instant.

ghs.en: Youko awoke in an instant from her light shut-eye,

rows.jp: ラジオを凝視する。
rows.en: She stared at the radio.

ghs.en: and stared, fixed, at the radio.

rows.jp: 深呼吸が聞こえた気がした。
rows.en: She thought she had heard someone take a deep breath.

ghs.en: She felt that she could hear a deep breath,

rows.jp: 懐かしい独特の気配を携えて。
rows.en: It carried a familiar, distinctive presence.

ghs.en: carrying with it a nostalgic, specific presence.

rows.en: “...This is... the Gunjo Academy Broadcasting Club...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...this... Gunjou Institute Broadcast Club."

rows.jp: 衝撃が曜子を射抜いた。
rows.en: The shock went straight through her.

ghs.en: The impact smashes through Youko.

rows.jp: ラジオを手に取る。
rows.en: She picked up the radio.

ghs.en: She takes the radio in her hand,

rows.en: That was all she could do.

ghs.en: and she could not do anything but that.

rows.jp: 録音することさえ、浮かばなかった。
rows.en: It did not even occur to her to record the transmission.

ghs.en: Not even the idea of making a recording came to her.

rows.jp: 「生きている人、いますか？」
rows.en: “Is anyone alive out there?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Are there people still living out there?"

rows.jp: ラジオが言った。
rows.en: The radio spoke.

ghs.en: That is what the radio said.

rows.jp: 間違いない。
rows.en: There could be no mistake.

ghs.en: No mistake.

rows.en: “...Tai... chi?”

ghs.en: Youko: "...Tai... chi?"

rows.jp: 「もしいるのであれば、聞いてください」
rows.en: “If anyone is there, please listen.”

highlights.text: It was desire.

highlights.text: Her weakness of not killing just even one person on the day of the massacre,
